app.name: Post Pulse
app.betaHint: Beta version: analyses your post performance only.
app.betaNote: Beta version. Post Pulse analyses your post performance export only, not followers, profile visitors or audience data.

welcome.title: See what works in your LinkedIn analytics export
welcome.promise: Your data never leaves your device. No account, no upload, no tracking.
welcome.dropActive: Drop the file to import it
welcome.sampleHint: Made-up posts, so you can look around first.

howTo.step1: On LinkedIn in your web browser, open your Post impressions stats on the home page.
howTo.step1Alt: LinkedIn home page with Post impressions marked in the left column
howTo.step2: Under “Most recent post performance”, choose Show all posts.
howTo.step2Alt: The Most recent post performance section with Show all posts marked
howTo.step3: At the bottom of the page, choose Load more again and again until all your posts are loaded.
howTo.step3Alt: The bottom of the post list with Load more marked
howTo.step4: Choose Export at the top of the page.
howTo.step4Alt: The top of the post list with Export marked
howTo.after: Then import the downloaded .xlsx file here. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo.redacted: Personal details in the screenshots are blurred.

welcome.restoreHint: Have a backup? Restore it here.

summary.title: Import complete
summary.replacedSample: The sample data was removed so your own posts stand on their own.
summary.backupText: Your data lives only in this browser. Clearing site data deletes it. Download a backup now and then.

import.already: Already imported: {{file}} is in your history.

otherAuthor.title: This file seems to be from another profile
otherAuthor.text: Your history has posts from {{existing}}, but this file has posts from {{incoming}}.

error.unexpected: Something went wrong while importing. Nothing was changed.

sample.banner: You're looking at sample data, not your own posts.

overview.noInsights: Nothing stands out yet. Import more posts to see trends.
overview.insightsIntro: The points that matter most right now, from your own numbers. They show what tended to go together, not what caused what.

filters.growingHint: Posts published in the last 7 days are still collecting impressions, so they look weaker than they will end up. They're left out of medians and comparisons unless you include them here (Settings sets the default).
filters.label: Filters
filters.explain: Your history is cut into blocks of {{days}} days, counted back from your latest export ({{date}}). Key numbers compare the selected block with the one just before it.
filters.explainAll: One window over your whole history ({{start}} to {{end}}), so there's nothing earlier to compare with.

medianImpressions.label: Median impressions
medianImpressions.definition: The middle value of impressions per post in this window. Medians aren't thrown off by one viral post.

medianReach.label: Median reach
medianReach.definition: The middle value of members reached per post: unique people who saw it.

breakouts.label: Breakout posts
breakouts.definition: Posts with at least {{multiplier}}× your median impressions over your whole history ({{threshold}}+ impressions).

comments.label: Comments
comments.definition: All comments on posts published in this window.

followersGained.label: Followers gained
followersGained.definition: Followers LinkedIn attributes to posts published in this window.

engagementRate.label: Engagement rate
engagementRate.definition: Median of (reactions + comments + reposts + saves + sends) ÷ impressions.

posts.title: Posts
posts.empty: No posts match. Try another search or clear the filters.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Every post as a dot, sized by comments and coloured by type. The line is the median of the last 7 posts; the shaded area is the selected window.
timeline.logUnavailable: Some posts have 0, so this chart uses a linear scale.
timeline.empty: No posts to show with these filters.
timeline.chartLabel_one: Timeline of {{formatted}} post by {{metric}}. The same data is in the table below.
timeline.chartLabel_other: Timeline of {{formatted}} posts by {{metric}}. The same data is in the table below.

formats.title: Formats
formats.descriptionMedian_one: Median impressions per post type, compared with your typical post ({{median}} across {{formatted}} post).
formats.descriptionMedian_other: Median impressions per post type, compared with your typical post ({{median}} across {{formatted}} posts).

oon.title: Reach outside your network
oon.description: Posts grouped by the share of impressions from people outside your network.

description.day: Impressions per day, with viral posts shown separately, and how many posts you published.
description.week: Impressions per week, with viral posts shown separately, and how many posts you published.
description.month: Impressions per month, with viral posts shown separately, and how many posts you published.

chartLabel.day_one: Daily impressions and posts over {{count}} day. The same data is in the table below.
chartLabel.day_other: Daily impressions and posts over {{count}} days. The same data is in the table below.
chartLabel.week_one: Weekly impressions and posts over {{count}} week. The same data is in the table below.
chartLabel.week_other: Weekly impressions and posts over {{count}} weeks. The same data is in the table below.
chartLabel.month_one: Monthly impressions and posts over {{count}} month. The same data is in the table below.
chartLabel.month_other: Monthly impressions and posts over {{count}} months. The same data is in the table below.

thresholds.title: Breakouts and viral posts
thresholds.intro: Breakouts are multiples of your own median impressions, so they fit any audience size. For viral posts you can choose between that and a fixed number.

error.viral-not-above: Viral must be higher than breakout.
error.impressions-range: Viral must be a whole number of impressions between {{imin}} and {{imax}}.

thresholds.viralMode: Count a post as viral when it reaches
thresholds.impressionsSource: Default 15,000: about the top 5 % of personal LinkedIn posts in an analysis of 476,465 posts from Sep 2025 to Feb 2026 (AuthoredUp); the median post had about 840. Many guides call 50,000+ viral, but without data behind it.

growing.label: Include growing posts by default
growing.hint: Posts younger than 7 days are still collecting impressions. You can still switch this per view.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything is stored only in this browser. Download a backup now and then; clearing site data deletes it.

restore.title: Restore this backup
restore.text_one: The backup has {{count}} post. How should it be combined with what's here?
restore.text_other: The backup has {{count}} posts. How should it be combined with what's here?
restore.mergeHint: Merge: adds missing posts and keeps the newest numbers for each post. Your settings stay.
restore.replaceHint: Replace: deletes what's here and puts the backup in its place, settings included.
restore.failed: The backup could not be restored. Nothing was changed.

delete.title: Delete all data?
delete.text_one: This deletes {{formatted}} post, its history, your imports and settings from this browser. It can't be undone.
delete.text_other: This deletes {{formatted}} posts, their history, your imports and settings from this browser. It can't be undone.

pwa.update: A new version of Post Pulse is ready.

share.title: Share your LinkedIn story
share.alphaHint: An early version: slides and wording may still change.
share.absoluteHint: Turn this off to show only changes and shares, for example if your numbers are small or you'd rather not publish them.
share.privacy: The slides are drawn in your browser and saved as a PDF on your device. Nothing is uploaded. On LinkedIn, add the PDF as a document to post it as a carousel.
share.failed: The PDF couldn't be created. Try again, or try another browser.
share.pickHint: Every slide is included, good news and bad. Untick the ones you don't want in the PDF; the closing slide with the app's address always stays.
